title: MacroCoachGUI
desc: Java Swing desktop application that connects to MacroCoachAPI to display dashboard summaries, add macro and weight entries, review history, and visualize fitness trends through a clean user interface.

title: MacroCoachAPI
desc: FastAPI backend for tracking bodyweight, macros, calorie targets, and weekly fitness trends. Built with relational models, validation schemas, dashboard endpoints, and analytics logic for the MacroCoach desktop client.

title: StatSide
desc: React sports analytics web app for comparing teams and players with API-driven data, reusable components, asynchronous requests, and dynamic stat cards.

title: CorBrawl
desc: Java Swing game featuring an infinite world, spike hazards, enemy spawns, and projectile combat. Built to practice game loops, collision detection, and object-oriented design.

title: Personal Website
desc: Responsive portfolio website with modular page styles, clean navigation, and a projects system driven by JSON data.

title: List Manager
desc: Tkinter list manager with multi-list tabs, autosave to JSON, and add/edit/delete/reorder item workflows.

title: Expense Tracker
desc: CLI expense tracker with JSON persistence, add/update/delete flows, and clean tabular viewing output.

title: Hangman Trivia
desc: Tkinter trivia + hangman game that pulls questions from an external API and updates UI state per answer.

title: Fitness Tracker
desc: CLI analyzer for MyFitnessPal exports with summaries and Matplotlib visualizations for calories, macros, weight, and exercise.

title: Mediocre Banker
desc: CLI bank account simulator with deposits, withdrawals, transfers, account folders, and JSON log files by date.

title: F1 Stats Visualizer
desc: F1 stats explorer using an API to chart standings and driver/team performance using Matplotlib.

title: Travel Planner
desc: CLI travel planner that validates date ranges, builds a packing checklist using rules, and saves itineraries to files.
